targets.rawSql:
SELECT  count() as count
FROM ${ds2} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
AND $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
AND $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
AND $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
AND $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
AND $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
AND $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
AND $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total requests - Summary ; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Percent of requests that have a SecurityRules header indicating they're protected by a security policy. Adjust 'Security Coverage Filter' to adjust coverage rate exclusion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  replaceOne(coalesce(${treeMapGroupBy},'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as item,
  count(*)  as count,
  /*Calculate the security Coverage as the number of items which have a security rule divided by total items*/
  countIf( length(splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[1])>0 )/count(*) as securityCoverage
FROM  ${ds2}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
AND $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
AND $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
AND $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
AND $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
AND $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
AND $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
AND $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
AND $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP BY item
HAVING securityCoverage <= ${secCovFilter}
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Security Coverage for Top 500 Hostname; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Security Coverage for Top ${treemapCells} ${treeMapGroupBy} (Excludes coverage rates above ${secCovFilter})

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[1] AS securityPolicy,  
  count(*)  AS count
FROM  ${ds2}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
  AND $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
  AND $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
  AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
  AND $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
  AND $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
  AND $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
  AND $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
  AND $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
  AND $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
  AND $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
  AND $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP by securityPolicy

panels.description: Percent of requests flagged by any security rule matching the 'Selected Security Rules' filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  replaceOne(coalesce(${treeMapGroupBy},'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as item,
  /*If path may contain the word 'undefined' then use this:   replaceOne(ifNull(concat(reqHost,reqPath),'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as reqPath, */
  count(*)  as count,
  countIf( length(splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[2])>0 )/count(*) as rate /*percent of requests with a rule triggered*/
FROM  ${ds2}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
AND $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
AND $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
AND $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
AND $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
AND $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
AND $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
AND $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
AND $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP by item
having rate > ${ruleRateFilter}
order by count desc
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Security rules triggered; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
    arrayJoin(splitByChar(':',splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[2])) as ruleID,
  /*If path may contain the word 'undefined' then use this:   replaceOne(ifNull(concat(reqHost,reqPath),'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as reqPath, */
  count(*)  as count
FROM  ${ds2}
where $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
and $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
and $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
and $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
and $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
and $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
and $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
and $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
and $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
and $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
and $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
and $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP by ruleID
order by count desc
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top RuleIDs; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top RuleIDs (not filtered by Selected Rules)

panels.description: Percent of requests matching any security rule in the 'Selected Security Rules' filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  replaceOne(coalesce(${treeMapGroupBy},'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as item,
  count(*)  as count,
  countIf( length(arrayFilter(x -> x in [${securityRules:sqlstring}], splitByChar(':',splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[2]) )) > 0)/count(*) as rate

FROM  ${ds2}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
AND $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
AND $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
AND $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
AND $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
AND $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
AND $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
AND $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
AND $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
AND $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP by item
having rate>=${ruleRateFilter}
order by count desc
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=% Selected Rules Triggered for Top 500 Hostname; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: % Selected Rules Triggered for Top ${treemapCells} ${treeMapGroupBy} (Excludes error rates below ${ruleRateFilter})

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  arrayJoin(splitByChar(':',splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[2])) as ruleID,
  count(*)  as count
FROM  ${ds2}
where $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
and $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
and $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
and $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
and $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
and $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
and $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
and $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
and $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
and $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
and $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
and $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
and $__conditionalAll(ruleID in (${securityRules:sqlstring}), ${securityRules})
GROUP by ruleID
order by count desc
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 500 rules from selected rules; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Percent of requests blocked by a security rule.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  replaceOne(coalesce(${treeMapGroupBy},'-'),'undefined','undefine_d') as item,
  count(*)  as count,
  countIf( splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[3] in [${securityRules:sqlstring}] )/count(*) as blockedRate
FROM  ${ds2}
where $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
and $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
and $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
and $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
and $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
and $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
and $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})
and $__conditionalAll(rspContentType in (${rspContentType:sqlstring}), ${rspContentType})
and $__conditionalAll(statusCode in (${statusCode:sqlstring}), ${statusCode})
and $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})
and $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
and $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})
GROUP by item
having blockedRate>=${ruleRateFilter}
order by count desc
LIMIT ${treemapCells}

SELECT  
  arrayJoin(splitByChar(':',splitByChar('|',coalesce(securityRules,'||'))[3])) as ruleID,
  count(*)  as count
FROM  ${ds2}
where $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
and $__conditionalAll(reqHost in (${reqHost:sqlstring}), ${reqHost})
and $__conditionalAll(reqPath in (${reqPath:sqlstring}), ${reqPath})
and $__conditionalAll(queryStr in (${queryStr:sqlstring}), ${queryStr})
AND $__conditionalAll(cliIP in (${cliIP:sqlstring}), ${cliIP})
and $__conditionalAll(country in (${country:sqlstring}), ${country})
and $__conditionalAll(state in (${state:sqlstring}), ${state})
and $__conditionalAll(city in (${city:sqlstring}), ${city})

and $__conditionalAll(errorCode in (${errorCode:sqlstring}), ${errorCode})

and $__conditionalAll(referer in (${referer:sqlstring}), ${referer})
and $__conditionalAll(UA in (${UA:sqlstring}), ${UA})

options.content:
RuleIDRuleNameRule Description
3991005Site Development and Monitoring Services (3991005)bots are operated by a vendor you hire to monitor your website's availability and performance. Some bots in this category also help developers test their changes. Verify with your website development and operations teams to see if they use such services on a regular basis.
3991006Web Search Engines (3991006)are software systems that let any user query the World Wide Web. Google and Bing, for example, crawl the internet collecting site info, so they can reference them to their users in search results. Akamai tracks over a 150 web search engine botnets that cater to a global or local user base. Web search engines help users find your website and may help you acquire new customers.
3991008Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Audience Analytics or Marketing Services (3991008)Bots that aid in an website's efforts to be high in a search engine's results list. Companies that offer these services also provide competitive analysis, audience studies, and public perception data.
3991009Social Media or Blog Bots (3991009)are operated by services that connect users through a platform, like Facebook. They scrape content that users share to display a summary. If social media is part of your marketing strategy, these bots may help you get customers.
3991010Online Advertising Bots (3991010)Advertisers scrape their clients' web sites to better understand what they offer. They also scrape the site where the ad appears to serve an ad that's appropriate for the page. Botnets in this category may help your marketing team with your online advertising strategy.
3991011E-Commerce Search Engine (3991011)Specialized search engines that focus on consumer goods like: clothing, furniture, books, electronics, ammunition, and cars.
3991012Media or Entertainment Search Engines (3991012)scrape and post content like videos or news articles then post them on their own 3rd-party site, which may mean a loss of revenue for you, unless you have an agreement to share content.
3991013Job Search Engine Bots (3991013)usually scrape a career section of a website to gather job descriptions to publish on their own portal. Depending on your hiring policy, you may not want this activity.
3991014Web Archiver Bots (3991014)Web content is ephemeral. Sites change continually and often disappear. Archivers devote themselves to retain websites or data that would otherwise be lost. They also let the public search their archives for information.

3991017Enterprise Data Aggregator Bots (3991017)offer scraping services to help clients get a competitive edge.
